property_summary: For every caller and inputs, calling sendMoney(...) does not allow a non-owner to subsequently decrease address(c).balance via withdrawAll on the correct contract (only the owner can withdraw); the mutant that removes the onlyOwner check enables some non-owner interactions to reduce address(c).balance, violating this rule.
change_summary: Modify onlyOwner to allow any caller (remove the require), so withdrawAll can be invoked by non-owner and thus change post-withdraw state.
